commit_message: Model runtime: sanitize files outside strict handoff targets

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


class SanitizeError(RuntimeError):
    pass


def _run(
    cmd: list[str],
    *,
    cwd: Path,
    check: bool = True,
) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
    proc = subprocess.run(
        cmd,
        cwd=str(cwd),
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
    )
    if check and proc.returncode != 0:
        raise SanitizeError(
            f"{' '.join(cmd)} fehlgeschlagen: "
            f"{(proc.stderr or proc.stdout).strip()}"
        )
    return proc


def _git(repo: Path, *args: str, check: bool = True) -> str:
    return _run(
        ["git", *args],
        cwd=repo,
        check=check,
    ).stdout.strip()


def _exists_in_base(
    repo: Path,
    base_ref: str,
    rel_path: str,
) -> bool:
    proc = _run(
        [
            "git",
            "cat-file",
            "-e",
            f"{base_ref}:{rel_path}",
        ],
        cwd=repo,
        check=False,
    )
    return proc.returncode == 0


def sanitize(
    repo: Path,
    base_ref: str,
    handoff: dict[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    strict = bool(
        handoff.get("strict_target_paths")
    )
    target_paths = {
        str(item)
        for item in handoff.get("target_paths", [])
    }

    changed = [
        line.strip()
        for line in _git(
            repo,
            "diff",
            "--name-only",
            f"{base_ref}...HEAD",
        ).splitlines()
        if line.strip()
    ]

    unexpected = sorted(
        path
        for path in changed
        if target_paths and path not in target_paths
    )

    if not strict or not unexpected:
        return {
            "ok": True,
            "strict_target_paths": strict,
            "changed": False,
            "unexpected_paths": unexpected,
            "restored_paths": [],
        }

    restored: list[str] = []

    for rel_path in unexpected:
        if _exists_in_base(repo, base_ref, rel_path):
            _git(
                repo,
                "restore",
                "--source",
                base_ref,
                "--",
                rel_path,
            )
        else:
            target = (repo / rel_path).resolve()
            try:
                target.relative_to(repo.resolve())
            except ValueError as exc:
                raise SanitizeError(
                    "Pfad außerhalb des Repository."
                ) from exc
            if target.is_dir():
                shutil.rmtree(target)
            elif target.exists():
                target.unlink()
        restored.append(rel_path)

    status = _git(
        repo,
        "status",
        "--porcelain=v1",
        "--untracked-files=all",
    )
    if not status:
        return {
            "ok": True,
            "strict_target_paths": strict,
            "changed": False,
            "unexpected_paths": unexpected,
            "restored_paths": restored,
        }

    _git(repo, "add", "-A")
    staged = _git(
        repo,
        "diff",
        "--cached",
        "--name-only",
    )
    if not staged:
        return {
            "ok": True,
            "strict_target_paths": strict,
            "changed": False,
            "unexpected_paths": unexpected,
            "restored_paths": restored,
        }

    branch = _git(
        repo,
        "branch",
        "--show-current",
    )
    if not branch.startswith("ai/job-"):
        raise SanitizeError(
            "Sanitizer darf nur auf isolierten ai/job-* Branches committen."
        )

    _run(
        [
            "git",
            "-c",
            "user.name=Hermclaw Runtime",
            "-c",
            "user.email=runtime@hermclaw.local",
            "commit",
            "-m",
            "Runtime: restore files outside strict handoff targets",
        ],
        cwd=repo,
    )
    _git(
        repo,
        "push",
        "origin",
        f"HEAD:{branch}",
    )

    return {
        "ok": True,
        "strict_target_paths": strict,
        "changed": True,
        "unexpected_paths": unexpected,
        "restored_paths": restored,
        "branch": branch,
        "head": _git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD"),
    }


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=(
            "Stellt bei strikt eingegrenzten Handoffs "
            "fachfremde Änderungen deterministisch wieder her."
        )
    )
    parser.add_argument("--repo", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--base-ref", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--handoff", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    repo = Path(args.repo).resolve()
    handoff = json.loads(
        Path(args.handoff).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    )
    result = sanitize(
        repo,
        args.base_ref,
        handoff,
    )

    Path(args.output).write_text(
        json.dumps(
            result,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        )
        + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    if result["changed"]:
        print(
            "[SANITIZE] Fachfremde Änderungen wiederhergestellt: "
            + ", ".join(result["restored_paths"])
        )
    else:
        print(
            "[SANITIZE] Keine Wiederherstellung nötig."
        )
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

import json
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from model_runtime.sanitize_result_branch import sanitize


def git(cwd: Path, *args: str) -> str:
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["git", *args],
        cwd=str(cwd),
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
        check=True,
    )
    return proc.stdout.strip()


class SanitizeResultBranchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_restores_unexpected_file_on_strict_job_branch(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            base = Path(tmp)
            remote = base / "remote.git"
            repo = base / "repo"

            git(base, "init", "--bare", str(remote))
            git(base, "clone", str(remote), str(repo))
            git(repo, "config", "user.name", "Test")
            git(repo, "config", "user.email", "test@example.invalid")

            (repo / "wanted.txt").write_text(
                "base\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            (repo / "noise.txt").write_text(
                "base\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            git(repo, "add", "-A")
            git(repo, "commit", "-m", "base")
            base_sha = git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
            git(repo, "push", "-u", "origin", "HEAD:main")

            branch = "ai/job-test-sanitize"
            git(repo, "checkout", "-b", branch)
            (repo / "wanted.txt").write_text(
                "wanted change\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            (repo / "noise.txt").write_text(
                "noise change\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            git(repo, "add", "-A")
            git(repo, "commit", "-m", "agent")
            git(repo, "push", "-u", "origin", branch)

            result = sanitize(
                repo,
                base_sha,
                {
                    "strict_target_paths": True,
                    "target_paths": ["wanted.txt"],
                },
            )

            self.assertTrue(result["changed"])
            self.assertEqual(
                (repo / "noise.txt").read_text(
                    encoding="utf-8"
                ),
                "base\n",
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                (repo / "wanted.txt").read_text(
                    encoding="utf-8"
                ),
                "wanted change\n",
            )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
